DeployBot: ALERT: us-west-2 embeddings-route p95 2.8x baseline over 4m. Auto-rollback suppressed (pin). https://dash.redwood/alerts/7077 :rotating_light:
Casey: noticing increased 5xx and latency, correlates with a manifest push ~6m ago.
Mei: stack traces showing a routing miss pattern and elevated kv miss rate. Could be manifest/regrowth during push.
Casey: pin prevents auto-rollback. Prefer unpin + staged reroute to avoid touching new migration toggles. OpsLead, agree?
OpsLead: agree. Plan: emergency unpin -> staged 10% -> observe 8-10m -> ramp if stable. Rollback only if staged route shows p95 > 2x baseline OR 5xx_rate > 1% sustained 3m. Freeze release notes and lock change window for 60m.
Jordan: rollback would hit a feature-flagged schema migration; high blast radius. Unpin is lower risk.
Mei: need CLI sequence and exact thresholds to automate monitoring.
OpsLead: Runbook snippet: ```
# emergency unpin + staged reroute
deployctl hold-new-releases --region=us-west-2
deployctl unpin --route=embeds-primary --staged=10 --until=2026-03-23T18:00Z
# monitor: p95, 5xx_rate, kv_miss for 8m. Escalate to rollback if p95 > 2x baseline OR 5xx_rate > 1% for 3m
```
Also add to release notes: "emergency unpin executed to mitigate routing churn; investigating manifest push".
CSLead: prepping a 2-line customer note and status page snippet for affected tenants.
Casey: I'll run the unpin now if OpsLead gives thumbs. EngOncall will post metric snapshots to #eng-oncall every 5m.
OpsLead: Casey, go for it. EngOncall, monitor and attach screenshots. CSLead, stand by to publish customer blurb if we escalate.
Casey: executing: ```deployctl unpin --route=embeds-primary --staged=10 --until=2026-03-23T18:00Z```
DeployBot: Action accepted: unpin started. Staged slice 10% -> https://deploy.redwood/actions/707777
EngOncall: telemetry at 10% slice: p95 trending down, now at 1.15x baseline after 90s. 5xxs decreasing. Continuing 8m observation window.
Mei: kv miss dropped 16% -> 5%. Looks like manifest churn was primary cause.
OpsLead: if stable at end of observation, ramp 10% -> 30% -> 65% in 5m increments. Keep change window locked; block merges to embeddings service.
CSLead: Draft: "We observed a transient latency increase for embeddings in us-west-2. We staged traffic to a stable variant and are seeing improvements. We'll provide a follow-up in 30 minutes." Ready to send once we confirm 30% ramp.
Casey: locking change window and release-notes freeze. Creating postmortem stub: https://docs.redwood/incident/707777-unpin. Thanks team :thumbsup:
